title: Nourishing Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Moroccan dish featuring lamb, mint, and spices, cooked to perfection in a tagine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, mint, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the tagine and transfer it to the oven, where it will cook at 300 degrees for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb and sauce over couscous or rice, garnished with fresh mint and parsley.
Store any leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
